notes.title: Small Update
notes.content: - Fixed bug where hidden object clues would not appear in-game if player had first read Ava's story in the main menu.

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
[b]Hello Adventurers![/b]

Some small updates to the demo:

- Change of control scheme
Mouse R + movement now moves the camera and Mouse L interacts with objects. This feels more      natural and allows rapid clicking of Mouse L without moving the screen by mistake.

- Fixed some objects not responding to interactions
- Fixed redundant 'Hint' button appearing in the bottom left of the screen when using the Hint Orb
